ui_elements.description: Set consistent indentation for all task levels using fixed pixel values per depth level. Indentation = depth * 2rem, no compounding.
ui_elements.implementation: Use data-depth attribute with explicit CSS selectors: [data-depth='0'] = 0, [data-depth='1'] = 2rem, [data-depth='2'] = 4rem, etc.
ui_elements.error_handling: If depth attribute missing, default to depth 0. Max depth capped at 10 levels for performance.
ui_elements.validation: Measure left margin of nested tasks; should be exactly depth * 2rem from left edge

ui_elements.description: Details pane opens ONLY when clicking the <span class='task-title'> element, not checkbox, icons, or task container background.
ui_elements.implementation: onclick='selectTask(id)' bound only to .task-title span, not .task-content div
ui_elements.error_handling: No action if click detected on .task-checkbox, .collapse-arrow, .drag-handle, or .task-actions elements
ui_elements.validation: Click tests: checkbox → no pane open, chevron → no pane open, title text → pane opens

actions.description: Click and drag the grip icon to reorder task or change parent
Double-click anywhere in task box (except interactive elements) to enable drag mode

ui_elements.error_handling: If drag attempted on locked task or invalid drop target, show red outline and snap back to origin. Display tooltip: 'Cannot move task here'
ui_elements.validation: Drag task with 3 subtasks to different parent; verify hierarchy updates correctly

ui_elements.behavior: Click ellipsis → show dropdown menu below icon, click outside → close menu
ui_elements.styling: Bootstrap dropdown component with custom positioning
ui_elements.error_handling: If menu opens off-screen (near bottom edge), position above icon instead. Close menu on ESC key.
ui_elements.validation: Open menu on task near bottom of viewport; verify menu appears above icon

ui_elements.description: When hovering any subtask (depth > 0), show parent task action buttons: 'Add Subtask' icon and ellipsis menu
ui_elements.implementation: CSS :hover on .task-row reveals .task-actions with opacity transition
ui_elements.error_handling: If no hover support (touch device), show actions permanently on focus
ui_elements.validation: Hover over 3rd-level subtask; verify action icons appear

ui_elements.label: + Add Subtask
ui_elements.description: Button at bottom of subtask list in details pane to add child task to currently selected task
ui_elements.error_handling: Disabled if no task selected. Show tooltip: 'Select a task first'
ui_elements.validation: Select task, click + button, add subtask; verify it appears in both list and details pane

ui_elements.description: Replace 'Subtasks' label with <hr> element above subtask list
ui_elements.validation: Open details pane; verify horizontal line appears instead of 'Subtasks' text

ui_elements.error_handling: If sidebar animation in progress, queue toggle action. Prevent rapid clicking.
ui_elements.validation: Click toggle; verify sidebar animates smoothly and button icon changes

ui_elements.label: Close
ui_elements.error_handling: Disabled if details pane already closed
ui_elements.validation: Click close button; verify pane closes and state resets

ui_elements.description: Pressing ESC key closes details pane if currently open
ui_elements.error_handling: No action if details pane already closed. Don't interfere with other ESC handlers (modals, dropdowns).
ui_elements.validation: Open details pane, press ESC; verify it closes. Press ESC again; verify no errors.

invalid_drag.response: Show red outline on task, snap back to original position, display tooltip: 'Cannot move task here'

sidebar_toggle_spam.condition: User rapidly clicks sidebar toggle multiple times
sidebar_toggle_spam.response: Debounce toggle action (300ms), queue only latest click, ignore intermediate clicks

steps: Create task with 5 levels of nesting
Measure left margin at each level
Verify: L1=0, L2=2rem, L3=4rem, L4=6rem, L5=8rem
Click task checkbox → pane should NOT open
Click collapse arrow → pane should NOT open
Click task text → pane SHOULD open
Click task background (not text) → pane should NOT open
Drag task by grip icon → should enable dragging
Double-click task box → should enable dragging
Try to drag task into its own child → should show error and snap back
Successfully drop task into valid location → verify task moves
Click ellipsis icon → menu opens
Click 'Delete' → confirmation dialog appears
Click outside menu → menu closes
Open menu on bottom task → verify menu appears above icon
Mark 3 tasks complete
Verify they disappear from main list
Verify 'Completed (3)' section appears at bottom
Click section header → verify tasks expand/collapse
Uncheck completed task → verify it returns to main list
Verify profile pic + 'Nested To-Do' text visible when expanded
Click bottom toggle → sidebar collapses
Verify only profile picture visible (no text)
Click toggle again → sidebar expands, text reappears
Open details pane by clicking task
Press ESC → pane closes
Press ESC again → no error
Click 'Close' button → pane closes
Try to close already-closed pane → no error
Test at 1920x1080 → all 3 columns visible
Test at 1366x768 → all 3 columns visible, content scales
Test at 1200x800 → details pane hidden below 1200px
Test at 900x600 → minimum supported resolution

remarks.drag_drop_implementation: Use SortableJS library for drag/drop. Configure with group names, handle callbacks for onEnd event to update task parent_id and position via API.
remarks.ellipsis_menu_bootstrap: Use Bootstrap's dropdown component. Add data-bs-toggle='dropdown' and aria-expanded attributes. Style dropdown-menu to match design.
remarks.completed_section_filtering: Backend should support filtering: GET /api/tasks?filter=active and GET /api/tasks?filter=completed. Frontend separates rendering based on is_done value.
remarks.profile_picture_future: Currently placeholder. Future enhancement: allow upload, integrate with user auth system.
remarks.esc_key_priority: ESC key should close details pane first, then menus/modals. Implement event.stopPropagation() to prevent conflicts.
remarks.double_click_drag_ux: Add visual feedback (outline or shadow) when double-click activates drag mode. Cursor should change to 'grabbing'.
remarks.localStorage_keys: Use consistent naming: 'nestedTodo_sidebarCollapsed', 'nestedTodo_completedCollapsed' for state persistence.
